findingsAddressed.title: Archive gate omits mandatory task completion and has no fact-availability behavior
findingsAddressed.rootCause: The spec 'Change-level Action 前置条件矩阵' archive precondition listed approved review, blocking findings=0, Verification passed, and owner authorization — but omitted task completion (required by docs/delivery-lifecycle.md Section 3.5: 'Tasks 已完成'). C1 FormalFactSnapshot exposes only change-tasks existence (OpenSpecArtifactFact kind='change-tasks', exists), with no task-completion field. The Proposal therefore had neither the required gate nor a fail-closed outcome when the fact was unavailable.
findingsAddressed.fix: Added 'Tasks 事实可用且全部完成' to the archive precondition. Added distinct fail-closed behavior: when Tasks completion facts unavailable, canRun(archive) returns allowed:false with unmetPreconditions containing 'tasks-facts-unavailable', next returns blocked:tasks-facts-unavailable. Added design decision D1-11 formalizing the gate + fail-closed handling parallel to D1-7, with strict distinction from verification-facts-unavailable. Added 2 spec scenarios (archive requires Tasks completed; Tasks unavailable → archive blocked), 1 diagnosis scenario, tasks-facts-unavailable to BlockedReason (1.6) and diagnose reasons (7.4), and table-driven test 10.21. MUST NOT infer completion from Run history / change-tasks exists / chat. Updated conclusion (scratch) archive row, apply decision tree, blocked diagnosis table, and snapshot availability matrix.
findingsAddressed.verificationEvidence: spec.md archive description now contains 'Tasks 事实可用且全部完成' and 'tasks-facts-unavailable'. New scenario 'Tasks 完成事实不可用时 archive blocked' asserts allowed:false + tasks-facts-unavailable + next blocked + no-inference. 'blocked diagnosis 条件' lists tasks-facts-unavailable distinct from verification-facts-unavailable. design.md D1-11 documents delivery-lifecycle.md Section 3.5 requirement + C1 snapshot gap + fail-closed. tasks 1.6/4.11/7.4/4.16/10.21 enforce. delivery-lifecycle.md:137 'Tasks 已完成' cited as formal-doc authority.

findingsAddressed.title: delivery-finalize permits an unrepresentable Full Test not-applicable state
findingsAddressed.rootCause: The spec 'Delivery-level Action 前置条件' delivery-finalize precondition said 'Full Test passed 或 not-applicable'. B1 FullTestStatus (src/domain/types.ts:49-54) = 'not-ready' | 'awaiting-user-decision' | 'authorized' | 'passed' | 'failed' — NO not-applicable value. 'not-applicable' belongs to Change VerificationStatus (types.ts:60-64 = 'not-run' | 'passed' | 'failed' | 'not-applicable'). The Proposal conflated a Change-level concept into a Delivery-level gate, permitting an unrepresentable state.
findingsAddressed.fix: Replaced 'Full Test passed 或 not-applicable' with 'snapshot.deliveryFullTestStatus = passed' in spec description and scenario. Added B1 FullTestStatus enum citation and statement that any non-passed value (incl. undefined) → allowed:false with 'full-test-not-passed'. Added design decision D1-12 documenting the enum, VerificationStatus distinction, complementarity with full-test action, and extensibility path. Added negative table-driven scenario covering all 5 non-passed values. Added tasks 4.13 fix, 4.17, and 10.22 (table-driven negative test). Removed 'Full Test passed 或 not-applicable' from all proposal bundle artifacts. Updated conclusion (scratch) delivery-finalize row.
findingsAddressed.verificationEvidence: spec.md delivery-finalize description now says 'snapshot.deliveryFullTestStatus = passed' and cites B1 enum (no not-applicable). New scenario 'delivery-finalize 在非 passed FullTestStatus 时拒绝' covers {not-ready, awaiting-user-decision, authorized, failed, undefined} → allowed:false + full-test-not-passed; asserts not-applicable not accepted. grep 'passed 或 not-applicable' in proposal bundle: only design.md:135 (removal documentation) — no accepting occurrence. All 9 'not-applicable' occurrences correctly attributed to VerificationStatus or removal-doc. B1 types.ts:49-54 confirms FullTestStatus has no not-applicable.

keyFindings: D1-PR-003 and D1-PR-004 are both content defects in the Proposal bundle, inheriting gaps from the explore conclusion.

D1-PR-003: delivery-lifecycle.md Section 3.5 requires 'Tasks 已完成' before Archive, but the spec/tasks omitted it; C1 snapshot has no task-completion field, so a distinct tasks-facts-unavailable fail-closed diagnosis is required (D1-11), parallel to D1-7's verification-facts-unavailable.
D1-PR-004: B1 FullTestStatus has no not-applicable value; not-applicable belongs to Change VerificationStatus. delivery-finalize must require deliveryFullTestStatus=passed strictly (D1-12).

tasks-facts-unavailable (archive Tasks gate) and verification-facts-unavailable (review-apply/archive Verification gate) are distinct fact dimensions; when archive faces both, unmetPreconditions lists both.
delivery-finalize (requires passed) and full-test (requires ≠ passed) are complementary gates — full-test runs when not passed, delivery-finalize proceeds only when passed.

D1-PR-001 (provenance) and D1-PR-002 (canRun(review-S) contradiction) remain resolved — 079's fixes are intact and unmodified.
